text: NSN (Never Say Never) is a global sports and event company co-founded by Andrés Iniesta, one of its main shareholders, and led by its president and founder Joel Borràs. In November 2025 Stoneweg became a shareholder of NSN as the two formed the joint venture behind the NSN Cycling Team.
short: NSN: Andrés Iniesta is a main shareholder; Stoneweg took a stake in 2025.

source.name: NSN Cycling Team, 'NSN and Stoneweg launch the NSN Cycling Team'
source.quote: Stoneweg becomes a shareholder of NSN, with the aim of continuing to support major projects in the world of sport and entertainment

additionalSources.quote: global sports and event company NSN (Never Say Never), co-founded by Spanish football legend Andrés Iniesta, and Swiss investment firm Stoneweg
